description: Write the supporting guides as ex_doc extras, built from existing material without duplicating it: Getting started (install as a dependency, path/git/Mix.install, the C compiler requirement, first kernel, calling it, reading a compile error); Testing kernels (Elixir mode as the oracle, assert_agrees, agreement properties, forced yields); Measuring (from examples/README.md Measuring correctly and the verdict rules: optimise Elixir first); The runtime contract (yielding, safepoints, failure isolation, what a kernel can and can't do to the VM; from docs/beam-nifs.md and README); Deploying (mix release, C compiler at build time per ADR 0002, examples/release_debian, defk-n8f's outcome); a cheatsheet (.cheatmd) of types, builtins and common rewrites. Decide whether docs/language.md stays one page or is split into several (types, expressions, arrays, control flow, calls, yielding, Elixir mode) with stable anchors; keep the docs example test covering every page.

comments.text: From defk-djy.5: the scope page is docs/scope.md (a Guides extra in mix.exs). Getting started should link it, e.g. 'When to use defk and when Elixir or a wrapper NIF is the better choice: [scope page](scope.md)' (from another extra, ex_doc resolves scope.md to scope.html).

Done on branch defk-djy.4/guides. Guides in docs/guides/ (how-to pages apart from the reference and project history in docs/): getting-started.md, testing.md, measuring.md, runtime-contract.md, deploying.md, plus cheatsheet.cheatmd in the Reference group. Main page: README stays main (what defk is and why, same as GitHub); Getting started comes right after it in Guides, and README now points to it. language.md split: kept as one page. Reasons: compile errors link docs/language.md#<code> and defk-djy.6 builds on those anchors; the docs checks (defk-djy.7) and scope.md resolve links into it; the cheatsheet now gives the quick lookup a split would have bought. Revisit with defk-djy.6 if the error catalogue becomes its own page. Checking: guide kernels run in both modes via the djy.7 runner; Defk.LanguageDoc.extras/0 now includes .cheatmd so the cheatsheet's examples run too. Not covered by the runner and checked by hand once in a scratch app: the ExUnit test-file snippets in testing.md (no kernel in the block) and the Mix.install measuring script in measuring.md (annotated skip). Honesty notes: Deploying describes defk-n8f (releases don't ship the .so) as an open gap with the _build copy workaround; runtime-contract says a native crash is still a node crash (defk-7dm); testing.md flags Defk.Test/Defk.Case as hidden pending defk-djy.2.

title: Guides: getting started through deployment
